experiment.skip_reason: Concurrent decoder-only and efficiency runs caused CPU offload of UL2 weights ('Some parameters are on the meta device device because they were offloaded to the cpu'). The resulting wall-clock would not be a meaningful per-query latency for UL2 on a clean GPU. The full UL2 inference numbers from our DL19/DL20 BEIR runs (~70-90 min for 43-54 queries, sequential, no batching, on a single 48 GB GPU with no concurrent process) imply roughly ~25 sec/q for the full pipeline, but this estimate is from end-to-end runs rather than the controlled latency harness used here.
